questions.stem: The spin-only magnetic moment value of $\mathrm{M}^{n+}$ ion formed among $\mathrm{Ni}, \mathrm{Zn}, \mathrm{Mn}$ and Cu that has the least enthalpy of atomisation is $\_\_\_\_$ . (in nearest integer) Here n is equal to the number of diamagnetic complexes among $\mathrm{K}_2 [\mathrm{NiCl}_4]$, $[\mathrm{Zn}(\mathrm{H}_2\mathrm{O})_6]\mathrm{Cl}_2, \mathrm{K}_3[\mathrm{Mn}(\mathrm{CN})_6]$ and $[\mathrm{Cu}(\mathrm{PPh}_3)_3\mathrm{I}]$
